feed.title: Operecs changes
feed.subtitle: Every feature, fix and security update in Operecs, newest first.

entry.title: Operecs 0.23.0
entry.content:
• The collapsed vertical tabs sidebar is slimmer (icons only, like Brave)
  • Terms of use (Settings → About)
  • The Extensions page's checkboxes and Remove button no longer overlap
  • Sync (Settings → Sync) — Settings, bookmarks, history, open tabs, addresses, site settings and your extension list on all your devices, end-to-end encrypted
  • AI agents (Settings → Privacy & Security) — Let Claude Code, Codex or any MCP tool on your Mac browse in their own Agent window, reading pages as compact outlines that cost far fewer tokens than screenshots
  • Protected streaming support (Widevine DRM). Some services, like Netflix, need one more step that comes in a later update
  • The browser engine is updated with the latest fixes (Electron 44.9.3)

entry.title: Operecs 0.22.3
entry.content:
• Dragging a file (PDF, image, web page) onto a page opens it, and dropping it onto the tab strip or toolbar opens it in a new tab
  • An Extensions button in the toolbar lists your extensions: pin or unpin their buttons, manage them, or get more from the Chrome Web Store

entry.title: Operecs 0.22.2
entry.content: • The Operecs logo and app icon now match the brand wordmark (Syne, with the lavender period)

entry.title: Operecs 0.22.1
entry.content: • Sites protected by Cloudflare (such as futbin.com) no longer get stuck on "Verifying you are human"

entry.title: Operecs 0.22.0
entry.content:
• Translate asks before sending a page's text to Google Translate the first time, and is never used in private windows
  • Sites can only register as handlers for safe link types (mailto:, web+…)

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.8
entry.content: • Vertical tabs — Restored balanced outer card frame with even 8px insets and rounded corners matching horizontal tabs mode

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.7
entry.content: • Silky-smooth bookmarks bar hover — Transformed the bookmarks hover bar into a hardware-accelerated floating overlay that slides and fades smoothly under the toolbar without resizing or shifting the web page

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.6
entry.content: • Vertical tabs layout refinement — Removed the floating page border frame and insets in vertical tabs mode so web pages sit flush edge-to-edge against the sidebar and toolbar, while preserving the card border and inset in horizontal tabs mode

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.5
entry.content:
• Full Keyboard Shortcuts customizer in Settings (and browser://shortcuts) with 60+ commands, live search filter, macOS physical key normalization, live conflict detection, ⌫ unassigning, and restore buttons
  • Compact toolbar option — Slim down toolbar buttons and address bar independently from compact tabs (Settings → Appearance & Toolbar)
  • Show Bookmarks bar only on hover — Hides the bookmarks bar until you hover over the toolbar area, giving you maximum screen space for web pages
  • Bookmarks bar overflow button (Brave style) — A chevron button (») appears when bookmarks exceed the window width to access hidden bookmarks and folders in a dropdown menu

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.4
entry.content: • Unified outer container for top toolbar and vertical tab sidebar with no divider line, rounded border frame around the webpage viewport, and removed the Default workspace button

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.3
entry.content:
• Vertical tab sidebar — The New Tab (+) button now sits directly under the latest tab instead of at the bottom
  • Collapsible vertical sidebar — Collapse to icons-only and expand on hover like Brave (all configurable in Settings → Appearance & Toolbar → Vertical Tabs & Sidebar)

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.2
entry.content: • Toolbar Screenshot button now asks whether to capture the Current Screen, Full Page, or Selection

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.1
entry.content: • Reader Mode toolbar icon is now off by default, and both Reader Mode and Media Controls can be toggled on or off in Toolbar Customization

entry.title: Operecs 0.21.0
entry.content:
• Calculator, unit conversions ("10 km in miles") and quick actions ("settings", "clear history") in the address bar
  • Tab groups (named, colored, collapsible) and workspaces to organize your tabs
  • Vertical tabs sidebar (⌥⌘V), side-by-side Split View (⌥⌘S), and tab hover preview cards
  • Two-finger trackpad swipe back and forward with an on-screen arrow
  • Cookie banner auto-reject and fingerprinting protection (canvas, WebGL and audio noise) in Settings → Privacy
  • Built-in screenshots (visible page, selection or full page), Read Aloud, in-page translation, and QR code sharing
  • Picture-in-Picture button in the media hub, and per-site autoplay permissions
  • Accent color themes, compact mode, customizable keyboard shortcuts, and installable web apps (PWA windows)
  • Single-tab screen sharing, client certificate selection, and custom protocol handlers (mailto:, web+…)
  • Redesigned Settings dashboard with category tabs and list pagination, plus a Settings toolbar button and customizable toolbar icons (right-click the toolbar or edit in Settings → Appearance & Toolbar)

entry.title: Operecs 0.20.0
entry.content:
• History moved into a fast database, with full-text search on the History page
  • Keep history for a chosen time, or clear history, downloads, cookies or cache whenever Operecs quits
  • Interrupted downloads continue where they stopped, even after quitting
  • A warning before a form on a secure page sends your data without encryption; the lock shows when a secure page loads anything insecurely
  • Closing a window or quitting asks first when a page has unsaved changes
  • Reloading a page you got by sending a form asks before sending it again (it used to do nothing)
  • Look Up, Speech and Emoji & Symbols in the right-click menu; Paste as Plain Text (Cmd+Shift+V)
  • The Bookmarks menu lists your bookmarks and folders, and bookmarks show their site icons
  • Extensions can be turned off without removing them, and their toolbar buttons hidden
  • Proxy settings, clearer pages when you're offline or a site can't be found, and help signing in to hotel and café Wi-Fi
  • Sites can connect to USB, serial, HID and Bluetooth devices you pick
  • Import history from Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi or Arc, and export all your data
  • Weekly checks for Electron security fixes, and urgent fixes install within minutes
  • Customize the new tab page — A background color or your own image, pinned and custom shortcuts with site icons, and hide shortcuts or bookmarks
  • Address autofill — Save your addresses and fill name, email, phone and address fields with one click
  • Profiles — Keep work and personal browsing completely separate, each with its own color
  • Mute a whole site from the tab menu
  • Tracking parameters (utm_, fbclid, gclid…) are removed from addresses you open
  • The new tab page counts the ads and trackers Operecs blocked
  • Energy saver — On battery, tabs you haven't used for 10 minutes go to sleep

entry.title: Operecs 0.19.0
entry.content:
• Theme setting — Match the system, dark or light
  • Drag a tab out to open it in its own window, or onto another window's tabs
  • A media button shows every tab playing audio or video, with play/pause
  • Sites only ask to show notifications right after you clicked or typed on them

entry.title: Operecs 0.18.0
entry.content:
• A new look — Tabs in the title bar, a dark canvas with violet accents, and pages in a rounded card
  • New tab, settings and every Operecs page redesigned to match, in light and dark

entry.title: Operecs 0.17.0
entry.content:
• Reader mode for articles, with text size, font, width and theme
  • The shield shows what was blocked on the page
  • A certificate viewer in the site information popup
  • Notifications show the site's name and open its tab when clicked

entry.title: Operecs 0.16.0
entry.content:
• Select several tabs with Cmd-click or Shift-click and act on them together
  • Sites ask before downloading several files on their own
  • Settings lists sites with cookies so you can remove their data
  • Custom search engines with keywords (type "w cats" to search Wikipedia)
  • Closing a tab with unsaved changes asks first
  • Share and Handoff on Mac
